evidence_items.explanation: Reporting on audited accounts supports losses in 2025, but does not identify the proposed cause or cover the entire claimed interval. It also describes substantial development expenses and a large restructuring-related accounting charge.

The study finds technical advantages alongside a large role for compute at the frontier, complicating a blanket absence-of-moat premise. Its 2022–2025 model sample does not estimate a causal effect on OpenAI's net losses.

unresolved_gaps: No retrieved evidence identifies the causal contribution of weak technical differentiation to OpenAI's losses.
The passage supplies no accounting basis that can be matched to decisive financial evidence.
The reported annual accounts do not establish continued net losses throughout January–July 2026.
Technical advantages need not constitute a durable commercial moat, and benchmark similarity does not prove their absence.
